title: Data visualization & statistics
summary: Read the data in context: distributions, uncertainty, relationships and meaningful segments.
reflection: I begin by examining how the data was collected, how it varies and which groups a headline result may conceal. Visualization and statistics help turn an apparent pattern into a question that can be investigated.
decision: What does the evidence say, and how uncertain is it?
methods: Visualization, probability distributions, correlation and clustering

title: Predictive modeling
summary: Estimate outcomes and evaluate predictions against the consequences of the decision.
reflection: Regression, classification and recommendation methods connect observed data to future outcomes. I evaluate generalization and choose metrics and thresholds that reflect the costs of different errors in the intended use.
decision: What is likely to happen, and which prediction errors matter most?
methods: Linear regression, logistic regression and collaborative filtering

title: Optimization
summary: Turn objectives, constraints and trade-offs into a feasible recommendation.
reflection: Optimization makes the decision explicit: what can change, what must be respected and what outcome is valuable. I check units, constraints and sensitivity so a recommendation remains connected to the operating conditions that support it.
decision: Which feasible action best serves the objective?
methods: Linear programming, sensitivity analysis, integer decisions and network flow

title: Advanced predictive modeling
summary: Model nonlinear relationships and test whether added complexity improves useful performance.
reflection: Trees and ensembles extend the predictive toolkit to more complex relationships. I assess performance on unseen data, class imbalance and the limits of feature explanations before using a model to guide a consequential choice.
decision: Does a richer model improve the decision on new data?
methods: Classification and regression trees, random forests and XGBoost

title: Deep learning
summary: Use learned representations to work with images, language and complex patterns.
reflection: Neural networks, transfer learning and NLP expand the kinds of information a system can use. I connect model outputs to task-specific validation, domain context and human review, particularly where a plausible output can still contain a consequential error.
decision: How can complex inputs support a reliable operational workflow?
methods: Neural networks, TensorFlow/Keras, transfer learning, NLP and transformers
